name: Hudson & Rex
description:
Detective Charlie Hudson teams up with what he calls his "highly trained law enforcement animal" German Shepherd dog named Rex who he prefers to team up with because he doesn't talk his ear off.

Based on the Austrian–Italian series, Kommissar Rex.

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: Detective Charlie Hudson teams up with what he calls his "highly trained law enforcement animal" German Shepherd dog named Rex who he prefers to team up with because he doesn't talk his ear off.

videos.title: Fearless Freaks
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex reveal a conspiracy within the parkour community, after a thrill-seeker falls to his death.

videos.title: Haunted By the Past
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex open up a cold case that may be connected to a recent case; Donovan asks Charlie to spy on his daughter.

videos.title: School Daze
videos.overview: When a controversial university professor is found dead in his classroom, Charlie and Rex investigate leads while Jesse goes undercover and soon finds himself in danger.

videos.title: The Pet Sitter
videos.overview: The animal lovers of St John's are under suspicion as Charlie and Rex investigate the death of a professional pet sitter. At home, Charlie finds himself in need of Sarah's help.

videos.title: Murder She Thought
videos.overview: When the pharmacist at Charlie's aunt's retirement home is found dead, she alerts him to a mysterious string of recent fatalities among the home's residents.

videos.title: Trial and Error
videos.overview: Sarah finds herself in the middle of a hostage situation at a medical testing lab. When the team realizes there's no way inside without aggravating the gunman, Charlies sends Rex in to monitor the situation.

videos.title: Fast Eddie's
videos.overview: After a reviled restaurateur's food truck explodes, killing one of his employees, Charlie and Rex find themselves with a few too many suspects. A flirtation has Charlie torn between a possible new love interest and Rex, who makes no secret of his feelings on the matter.

videos.title: The Mourning Show
videos.overview: Charlie investigates the host of a local morning show after her media mogul husband is suddenly found dead.

videos.title: Art of Darkness
videos.overview: With a gallery curator found murdered on his showroom floor and a missing sculpture, Charlie, Rex and Sarah are thrown into the world of high art. Jesse feels the burn when Sarah picks him as her new running buddy.

videos.title: Bad Water Rising
videos.overview: When an activist is killed during a break-and-enter at a water bottling plant, all evidence points towards his partner-in-crime, but Charlie and Rex aren't convinced.

videos.title: A Cult Education
videos.overview: When Donovan's ex, a recovering addict, wakes up with blood on her hands and a dead roommate in her apartment, the team moves quickly, finding there's more to the story.

videos.title: The Rex Files
videos.overview: When a deadly car accident leads Charlie and Rex to investigate reports of a mysterious blue light in the sky, they discover the truth is more science than fiction.

videos.title: Man of Consequences
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex discover a wanted criminal has been living in St. John's under a false identity for twenty years and end up in the crosshairs when the man's past catches up with him.

videos.title: Over Ice
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex investigate the death of a figure skating coach who's found dead on her club's ice rink.

videos.title: Blind Justice
videos.overview: When a body is found in a shipping container, Charlie teams up with a female cop from his past to solve the crime, Rex is not a fan and keeps getting between the two, keeping the path clear for Charlie and Sarah.

videos.title: Strangers in the Night
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex pull apart the secrets of a local band when their lead singer is found dead on the beach.

videos.title: Dead Man Walking
videos.overview: The clock is ticking as Charlie and Rex attempt to find a murderer before their victim can succumb to the poison slowly killing them.

videos.title: Under the Influencer
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex are on the case after a social media star dies while live streaming her wedding.

videos.title: The Woods Have Eyes
videos.overview: As Charlie and Rex head into the woods to track a missing photographer, a mysterious organization throws the investigation off its trail.

videos.title: Game of Bones
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex investigate a fantasy role-playing game turned deadly when a player is found slain by a sword.

videos.title: Bullet in the Water
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex are in deep water after a university rower is shot by a sniper during team practice.

videos.title: The French Connection
videos.overview: Cultures clash when the death of a Parisian journalist has Charlie and Rex partnering with a French detective, in an investigation that whisks the team to Saint Pierre and Miquelon.

videos.title: Rex-Machina
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex follow the route of a killer after a tech engineer is found dead in her company's self-driving car.

videos.title: Rex and the City
videos.overview: When a prominent member of an exclusive dating app is found with an arrow through his heart, Charlie is forced to go undercover in the online dating scene.

videos.title: In Pod We Trust
videos.overview: When the circumstances of a murder appear to mimic a crime from 20 years earlier, Charlie and Rex must connect the past to the present while fending off an interfering true crime podcaster.

videos.title: Tunnel Vision
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex head underground into a supposedly haunted mine after a crew member turns up dead during a horror film shoot.

videos.title: Finger Foodie
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex investigate the long list of enemies surrounding a vitriolic celebrity chef after a finger turns up in his Beef Wellington.

videos.title: Flare of the Dog
videos.overview: On the trail of a serial arsonist, Charlie is hospitalized after a brush with a bombing breaks his leg. Unable to let the case rest through his recovery, Charlie works the evidence from his bed, hoping to identify the arsonist

videos.title: The Graveyard Shift
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex find themselves at the mercy of a dangerous crime kingpin from their past when they enlist his help on a case.

videos.title: Old Dog New Tricks
videos.overview: When Sarah's former professor is seemingly framed for murder, Sarah calls Charlie and Rex to untangle the perfect crime.

videos.title: In a Family Way
videos.overview: After a woman is found dead in the snow, Charlie and Rex have a pool of unconnected suspects with only on thing in common -- the victim was convinced they were all her family.

videos.title: Origin Story
videos.overview: On the third anniversary of Charlie and Rex's partnership, Charlie recounts how a high-stakes kidnapping brought the duo together on their first case.

videos.title: Manhunt
videos.overview: On the hunt for an escaped murderer, Charlie and Rex are held hostage. But when a greater threat emerges, Charlie and his captor are forced to work together if they're going to make it out alive.

videos.title: Into the Wild
videos.overview: After a mummified body is discovered in Newfoundland's tundra, Charlie and Rex set off in search of a community of survivalists who may be harbouring a murderer.

videos.title: Under Pressure
videos.overview: When a scuba diver washes ashore with his oxygen supply severed, Charlie dives into the Atlantic Ocean to uncover the secret he was killed to protect.

videos.title: Prescription Rex
videos.overview: The near poisoning of a wealthy socialite throws the team into a perilous investigation that puts Charlie, Rex, and even Jesse in harm's way.

videos.title: Endless Summer
videos.overview: A young woman is abducted from the very spot her friend was murdered two years earlier; Charlie and Rex race against time as they trail the suspects from the original investigation.

videos.title: All in the Litter
videos.overview: Rex is on trial after his DNA is discovered at the scene of the murder of Donovan's former police informant.

videos.title: Sleeping Beauty
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex investigate a fairytale-turned-nightmare when a princess performer suspiciously dies at a child´s birthday party.

videos.title: Grave Matters
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex are in grave danger as they find themselves captives of a kidnapper seeking vengeance.

videos.title: Fanning the Flames
videos.overview: When an arsonist begins terrorizing a neighbourhood with car bombs, Charlie and Rex race to find the next target before the case goes up in smoke.

videos.title: Blood on the Tracks
videos.overview: When a murder appears to mimic an infamous crime spree from the past, Charlie and Rex rush to stop the culprit from continuing a serial killer´s legacy.

videos.title: Top Dog
videos.overview: Charlie lets Rex take the lead as they investigate a murder at a prestigious dog show.

videos.title: Mansion on a Hill
videos.overview: Trapped in an isolated mansion during a storm, Charlie and Rex must uncover a wannabe-killer after the hostess is drugged, while Sarah fights to keep her alive.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Levi
videos.overview: Jesse's friend vanishes; Charlie and Rex discover the man was living two separate lives.

videos.title: Seeing Is Deceiving
videos.overview: A magician dies during a practice-run of her latest routine; Charlie and Rex must look beyond the smoke and mirrors to uncover the truth.

videos.title: The Art of the Steal
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex witness an armed robbery during a trip to the bank; they discover a connection to a string of ingenious unsolved heists.

videos.title: Sid and Nancy
videos.overview: When two hikers are discovered murdered near a remote coastal trail, the team is on the hunt for a fugitive duo wanted in a series of grisly campsite murders.

videos.title: Oops I Bit It Again
videos.overview: When a troubled popstar is suspected of killing her fiancé, the team's investigation uncovers the distorted loyalties formed when personal ties meet the trappings of fame.

videos.title: Rex Marks the Spot
videos.overview: After a journalist is killed searching for buried pirate treasure, Charlie and Rex dig deep into the competitive world of treasure-hunters to unearth the killer.

videos.title: Leader of the Pack
videos.overview: While Sarah embarks on a wilderness adventure, Charlie and Rex investigate the murder of a college professor.

videos.title: Rex to Riches
videos.overview: A stock market guru's fortune is stolen, setting Charlie and Rex on the trail of a very surprising thief.

videos.title: Dead Man's Bridge
videos.overview: After a truck transporting liquid explosive is hijacked by criminals, Charlie and Rex find themselves in a race against time to prevent the case from blowing sky high.

videos.title: A Stab in the Dark Web
videos.overview: As Major Crimes investigates a dark web marketplace, Charlie and Rex protect a witness in their home.

videos.title: Sudden Death
videos.overview: After an elite hockey prospect is found dead, Charlie and Jesse disagree over the prime suspect in the case.

videos.title: Impawster Syndrome
videos.overview: The Major Crimes team is forced to turn against Jesse when he becomes the prime suspect in a bank robbery.

videos.title: Blood & Diamonds
videos.overview: After a raw diamond is found at the crime scene of a murder, Major Crimes sets up a stakeout to take down the suspected gem smugglers. An undisclosed team connection threatens to derail the investigation.

videos.title: Capital Punishment
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex receive an award for heroism while Major Crimes investigates an extremist threat.

videos.title: No Man Is an Island
videos.overview: Charlie, Rex and Sarah travel to an isolated island community caught up in a resettlement dispute. Donovan tries to stop a British police officer from derailing the investigation.

videos.title: Roses of Signal Hill
videos.overview: Rex's starring role in a television commercial is interrupted by the murder of one of the agency's ad executives.

videos.title: Roll the Bones
videos.overview: After the owner of a construction company is found dead, Charlie and Rex track the killer to an underground casino. Major Crimes goes undercover to solve the case.

videos.title: Nightmare on Water St.
videos.overview: While St. John's celebrates Mardi Gras, Charlie and Rex investigate a targeted killing spree.

videos.title: Dog Days Are Over
videos.overview: When Officer Maya Power and her K9 partner Rebel are violently attacked responding to a call about a warehouse break-in, Major Crimes is at the ready.

videos.title: Lost in the Barrens
videos.overview: When a young woman goes missing in The Barrens, suspicion turns to the woman's boyfriend; it's up to the team to uncover the truth behind her disappearance.

videos.title: Punch Drunk Glove
videos.overview: When Charlie's estranged brother is accused of the death of his recent boxing opponent, Charlie and the team wrestle with the possibility of his guilt.

videos.title: Run, Donovan, Run
videos.overview: When Superintendent Donovan transports an inmate, who happens to be his former partner, he finds himself confronting the past and caught up in a daring and dangerous escape.

videos.title: Hand of Cod
videos.overview: After a severed hand is found in a box of frozen cod, the team must uncover the identity of both the victim and the killer behind the grisly crime.

videos.title: The Good Shepherd
videos.overview: When Rex is accused of attacking a decorated former police officer, Charlie enlists the help of an unorthodox ally to uncover the truth in the hopes of restoring Rex's position on the team.

videos.title: Den of Snakes
videos.overview: When the co-owner of a successful board game company is found dead of a snake bite, the team has to not only catch the hugger but also the deadly venomous snake still on the loose.

videos.title: The Date Escape
videos.overview: After two killers escape from St. John s Women s Penitentiary, the team is stymied in their attempts to capture the duo when their antics turn them into modern-day folk heroes.

videos.title: Bury the Lead
videos.overview: When Supt. Donovan's journalism student daughter investigates the story behind a murder on her university campus, the team races to find the killer before someone else becomes the next victim.

videos.title: Rexpert Witness
videos.overview: When an important trial is jeopardized after Sarah s testimony is challenged by a former rival in court, it s up to Charlie, Rex, and the rest of the Major Crimes team to uncover new evidence to save the case before time runs out.

videos.title: One Wild Night
videos.overview: When the maid-of-honor winds up dead after a bachelorette party, it s up to Charlie and Rex to untangle the events of the night.

videos.title: Working for the Weekend
videos.overview: When Rex finds a body with signs of foul play during Charlie and Sarah's romantic weekend getaway, they discover the idyllic community they're staying in may be more hostile than it looks.

videos.title: Lost Lives Club
videos.overview: After a popular physiotherapist is murdered, the team must investigate the victims of his alleged sexual assaults in order to track down the killer before they strike again.

videos.title: The Miranda Act
videos.overview: When Charlie's beloved Aunt Miranda and her friends are caught investigating an investment fraud scheme, it's up to Charlie and Rex to get to the source of the fraud.

videos.title: Rexit, Stage Left
videos.overview: When a famous starlet is killed onstage during a preview performance of abeloved Newfoundland play, Rex takes on a starring role while Charlie goesbehind the scenes.

videos.title: Northern Rexposure
videos.overview: When Jesse s sister contacts him for help, he, Sarah and Rex head to Northern Ontario and find themselves in the middle of a deadly situation.

videos.title: Due North
videos.overview: Rex seeks help from Detective Sidney Scott to save his stranded and injured friends.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Charlie gets a break in a long-unsolved kidnapping case that has haunted him, but runs into trouble when the abductee refuses his help.

videos.title: Jail Break
videos.overview: An imprisoned killer forces the station into lockdown by taking a hostage and attempting escape.

videos.title: The Cook, the Chief, the Cop and His Lover
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex sniff out the suspects when the Chief Superintendent of the St. John's Police Department dies at a popular restaurant and all signs point to poison.

videos.title: One for the Road
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex try to take down a car theft ring after one of the team is seriously injured trying to stop a theft in progress.

videos.title: Ghost Ship
videos.overview: When a local whale watching boat mysteriously returns to harbor without its passengers, Charlie and Rex must race against time to find the missing tourists.

videos.title: The Good, the Bad, and the Rex
videos.overview: As a pair of armed robbers rip through St. John's, Charlie and Rex work fast to stop them by uncovering the truth behind the spree.

videos.title: Hound & Vision
videos.overview: When a prominent Judge disappears, Charlie and Rex piece together the crime with the help of a blind true crime podcaster who insists she heard a murder but could not see the culprit.

videos.title: Hour of the Dog
videos.overview: In a case that unfolds in real-time, Charlie and Rex have one hour to disarm a masked gunman holding the employees of an insurance office hostage.

videos.title: Hero by Night
videos.overview: A murder in a local park points to someone dressed as The Night Keeper.

videos.title: Claws Out
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex investigate the murder of a wealthy man who leaves only his three dogs to his estranged friends.

videos.title: Dancer, Traitor, Shepherd, Spy
videos.overview: An instructor at a prestigious Ballet School dies mysteriously, and Charlie and Rex discover he has ties to Russian spies.

videos.title: Doghouse
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex go undercover in prison to investigate the murder of David Aziz.

videos.title: Hudson and Son
videos.overview: When a police officer is killed in the nightlife district, the case narrows on a group of Navy officers.

videos.title: Who's Your Caddy?
videos.overview: Jennica Malouf, a wealthy socialite, turns up dead on a golf course.

videos.title: Dog and Pony Show
videos.overview: Charlie fears the worst after Rex goes missing while investigating the theft of a champion horse.

videos.title: Bark and Bite
videos.overview: A convicted killer resorts to drastic measures to avoid deportation, leading Charlie and Rex to re-open his case.

videos.title: Dogged Pursuit
videos.overview: When Sarah's old friend suffers an attack that leaves him in a coma, she travels to Toronto to confront his wife, while Charlie and Rex find suspects closer to home.

videos.title: Death on the Doorstep
videos.overview: Charlie and Rex's home turns into a crime scene when they find a stranger dying in their kitchen.

videos.title: Wag the Dog
videos.overview: When a so-called time traveler warns Major Crimes about a bomb threat, Charlie and Rex are enlisted to protect a prominent political figure at risk of assassination.

videos.title: Rex, Drugs & Rock n' Roll
videos.overview: When Jesse's music teacher is killed at his recording studio, Charlie and Rex link the crime to a seemingly unrelated murder.

videos.title: Double Dog Dare
videos.overview: When a murder investigation devolves into a kidnapping, Rex's nose leads him and Charlie to Bell Island, and right into the middle of a double murder plot.

videos.title: A Room with a Clue
videos.overview: With the rest of the team racing to stop an illicit weapons sale, Rex resolves to bring justice all on his own when he witnesses a murder while stuck at home.

videos.title: Shuck Everlasting
videos.overview: Donovan tracks a marine smuggling operation, the team investigates the night of a wedding to uncover why the best man ended up at the bottom of the Atlantic.

videos.title: K9: The Rext Generation
videos.overview: A K9-in-training leads her partner to a real crime scene, she uses her personal connection to the case to help Major Crimes bring justice to the victim s family.

videos.title: In From the Cold
videos.overview: After the confrontation between a murder writer and a victim's wife goes viral, the team reopens the seven-year-old cold case, uncovering new evidence.

videos.title: Bee-Deviled
videos.overview: When the president of a beekeeping association is found stung to death, a foreboding note leads the team to investigate who was willing to kill to be the new queen bee.

videos.title: Kiss the Cod and Make Them Die
videos.overview: Jesse and Stella's band gig goes sour when they become the victims of a mass poisoning, becoming key witnesses in piecing together a deadly night at the pub.

videos.title: Hot Prowl in the City
videos.overview: After a man is stabbed by an intruder who left no trace of a break-in, Rex s senses reveal it was only a practice run for a scheme that goes much deeper.

videos.title: Into the Wilds
videos.overview: When the sole witness against the son of a powerful mob boss goes missing in the woods, it's up to Mark, Rex and Jesse to track him down. The mob boss has already hired an assassin to find the witness.

videos.title: Runaway Witness
videos.overview: A young lawyer is snatched off the street, but the team can't track her down until they locate the sole witness - a child who disappeared from the scene. Rex connects with the traumatized boy, who communicates primarily through drawing. The team races to uncover who is behind the kidnapping and at the centre of a money laundering scheme before the criminal rids themselves of their depreciating asset.

videos.title: Best Kind
videos.overview: When businessman Jake Kaufman is found dead on his yacht, all suspicion falls onto a deckhand who ran from the scene. As Mark and Rex search for motives and clues, it seems that the businessman's missing watch might be what the killer was after... But with Rex being unable to find traces of the watch on any of the suspects, the hunt for the elusive watch and the killer becomes a race against time to save another life.

videos.title: Of All the Gin Joints
videos.overview: An announcement on the future of the Devereaux Gin Distillery is cut short when the owner is found drowned in his own spirits. The three heirs to the family business become prime suspects as Rex sniffs out the secret ingredient behind a groundbreaking new gin recipe, while Mark revisits the night of the murder to put the family drama to rest.

videos.title: Fortitude Newfoundland
videos.overview: When a survivalist competition broadcasts a finalist's body live on air, the team must figure out who was serious about burying their competition. Mark and Rex discover that the staged bear attack was actually murder, but the show must go on. Rex's keen hearing reveals a dead giveaway in the botched broadcast, leading the team to stage their own finale to catch the killer - live on TV.

videos.title: Conspiracy Theory
videos.overview: When a conspiracy theory podcaster is found murdered just before her talk at the TruthCon conference, Mark, Rex and the team find themselves thrown into the extreme world of conspiracy theorists. They find that one of the theorists is Mark's old commanding officer, now afflicted with PTSD. In the end, it's Rex's relationship with the old soldier that might lead them to the real killer.

videos.title: Criminal Rex
videos.overview: Sarah and Rex are kidnapped by an old enemy - criminal mastermind Rupert Mankiewicz. Mankiewicz's mission is to exact revenge by weaponizing Rex. Mark and Jesse launch a desperate investigation to find them before Mankiewicz can fulfill his deadly mission.

videos.title: Bird's Eye View
videos.overview: Birdwatching tourists are ruffled when they spy the body of a landowner who had hidden the nesting site of the rare Red Crossbills from them. When the team unearths a ruby from a 25-year-old jewelry heist connected to the case, Rex tracks the birdsong to find the treasure at the secret nesting site, before the killer can get there first and destroy the endangered birds standing in his way.

videos.title: All the Wrong Moves
videos.overview: When a pro wrestler is murdered days before a charity event, Mark and Rex must unmask the villain to save an animal shelter.

videos.title: Murder Al Fesco
videos.overview: When a master painting instructor is pushed off a cliff, Mark and Rex scope out the art world to get to the bottom of a picture-perfect murder

videos.title: Trial by Fire
videos.overview: When firefighter trainees discover a real cadaver during a controlled fire exercise, Mark and Rex follow one burning clue after another.

videos.title: The Briny Deep
videos.overview: After a fisherman's body is reeled in with the morning haul, every suspect seems to have an alibi, but the team senses something fishy about the autopsy.

videos.title: Heist for the Holidays (1)
videos.overview: After a robbery interrupts the team's holiday plans, Mark and Rex must track down the masked members of a Newfoundland mummering gang.

videos.title: Heist for the Holidays (2)
videos.overview: With Rex and a puppy lost in the wilderness days before Christmas, Mark races to reunite with his partner.
